plugin.notes: 2.7.0: the plugin no longer reads Orca's device list (it holds each phone's credentials). See and remove paired phones under Paired devices on Orca's Mobile page; click Done, hide code after pairing. Since 2.6.0 Orca installs plugin updates (Settings → Plugins → Update).

relay.notes: Relay 1.2.0: Deploy-button Workers are locked to the first desktop (no one else can use your Worker or its quota), max 4 phone connections per IP, smaller pre-connection buffer.
